name: bb_squeeze_breakout_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY's 5-minute Bollinger Band width compresses below the 10th-15th percentile of the prior 1-hour distribution, systematic market-making algos narrow their quotes and momentum programs stand aside — the index is in a low-uncertainty microstructure regime with order flow evenly balanced. The breakout fires when NIFTY closes outside the compressed band on above-average volume, triggering cascading entries from rule-based trend-following algorithms and breakout systems that share similar momentum filters. On NIFTY specifically, these cascades sustain for 30-90 seconds because FII-dominated institutional flow executes in TWAP/VWAP waves, meaning the initial breakout price is only partially absorbed and each subsequent 5-second bar sees renewed directional order pressure — a directional autocorrelation window that equity names lack.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-minute Bollinger Band width below 15th percentile of 1-hour history followed by close outside band with 1.5x volume surge
